Task Name: Remove tracked env files and rotate credentials
Description: Stop tracking local .env files, preserve .env.example, document rotation, and rotate any values that were committed.
User Value: Prevents credential leakage and sets safe contributor practice.
Current State: .env, .env.development, and .env.production are tracked. .gitignore now blocks future env files.
Gap / Risk: Existing git history may contain usable values.
Suggested Codex Prompt: Remove tracked env files safely, keep local files ignored, update security docs, and list every credential that must be rotated without printing values.

Acceptance Tests: git ls-files .env .env.development .env.production returns nothing; app still runs with local env values.
Notes: Do in a dedicated security PR to avoid casually exposing deleted values in diffs.
